---
title: "Readmissions"
format: revealjs
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| include: false
df <- read.csv("data/readmissions.csv")
all <- subset(df, ward == "All wards")
all$after <- all$quarter >= "2025 Q1"
before <- mean(all$rate[!all$after])
after <- mean(all$rate[all$after])
fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
change <- round((after / before - 1) * 100)
```

## The question

Did the new discharge protocol reduce 30-day readmissions?

## What we found

Readmissions fell from `r fmt(before)`% to `r fmt(after)`%.

## Readmissions fell by `r abs(change)`% after the new protocol

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of the 30-day readmission rate per quarter for all wards: about 18% in 2024, about 12% from 2025 Q1, when the new protocol started."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(all, aes(quarter, rate, fill = after)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey70", `TRUE` = "#003C7D"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "30-day readmission rate (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```
